title: code-2 DoCommand
description: Send with any Viam SDK: GenericService 'code-2' DoCommand. Get live goals and selectors from {"action":"describe"}. Commands that move need workcell_ready: true, set only after a person confirms the workcell is clear. Long commands return immediately; poll {"action":"status"} until busy is false.

select.description: left/right as seen by the overview camera; index counts cubes left to right; only = exactly one cube must be visible

oneOf.description: goal name: ring or a configured box name

request_id.description: unique per attempt; a repeat is ignored

name.description: measure_box: name for the new box

workcell_ready.description: required true for reset and recover_limits
